The Volvo EX60 has the BMW iX3 in its sights! But is it the better car?
Volvo’s all-new mid-size SUV is here!
The Volvo EX60 is a practical, all-electric SUV with a range of over 500 miles. The thing is, though, the BMW iX3 has already been around for a while, also runs for over 500 miles on a single charge, and will cost you less than the Volvo!
But is the Volvo a better choice? Let’s get into it, starting with the design.
